types.description: Abstract base layout — the shared root subtype for object-level UI surfaces. A layout attaches a presentation concern (grids, forms, tabs, cards) to an object. The base carries no attrs of its own; concrete subtypes add their presentation attrs. Not authored directly: a `layout.base` node fails to load (ERR_ABSTRACT_SUBTYPE_AUTHORED) — this subtype is a registry anchor concrete subtypes inherit from, never a node in a document.
A metadata-driven data grid attached to an object: declares the displayed columns, page size, default sort, and an optional preset filter the generated grid renders.
